messages:
Kevin: T-minus 45 for carrier-wave deploy (us-west). Owning rollout + smoke. Timeline: start canary at T=0, traffic ramp per plan. Please ack and call out blockers.

Maria (SRE): ack. I'll kick off warmup probes at T-10 and watch p50/p95. Alert thresholds set at +30% latency or 1% error rate.

Sam: Traffic split config ready:
```
# rcli traffic plan
1% -> 5% (10m) -> 15% (10m) -> 50% (10m)
on-error: halt + rollback
```
I'll apply at T=0 unless someone objects.

Jess: CR merged, infra flag `carrier_wave_enabled` toggled in staging. No infra changes in prod. Runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/carrier-wave-deploy

Andrew: No DB migrations. I'll be on standby for any connection spikes. Ping me if you see >10s tail latency.

Kevin: Quick preflight checklist — react with :thumbsup: when done:
- Readiness probes green
- Metrics dashboards open (rls-42)
- Rollback command verified
- Pager oncall aware

deploy-bot: Canary pool created: service=rls-42, rev=20260317-rc3, started=3112233500

Sam: Applying traffic split now in 5m window.

Maria (SRE): Warmup probes started. Initial token warm caches primed.

Jess: :thumbsup: CR + flags done.

Andrew: :thumbsup: monitoring ready.

Kevin: If no objections, I will flip canary at T=0. Final ack please.

Sam: :thumbsup:

Maria (SRE): :thumbsup: monitoring will escalate on anomalies.

deploy-bot: Traffic split set -> 1%

Kevin: Launching canary now. Will post status updates every step.

[later]
Kevin: Canary at 5% — metrics look clean. Rolling to 15% in 10m.

Maria (SRE): p95 down, error rate 0.2%. Continuing.

deploy-bot: Traffic split set -> 15%

Kevin: 50% in 10m if no regressions. Rollback plan:
```
rcli rollout rollback --service rls-42 --to rev=20260317-rc2
```

Jess: Noted.

Andrew: Oncall will page if >1% errors.

Kevin: good job team. Final cutover at T+40 if all stable. :tada:
